newsitem.title: USA: Shared Tech stakeholder to vote for merger.
newsitem.headline: Shared Tech stakeholder to vote for merger.

text.p: A New York-based investor group with a 6.3 percent stake in Shared Technologies Fairchild Inc said Wednesday that it would vote in favor of the company's planned merger with Tel-Save Holdings Inc.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group including James Cramer also said its latest transactions involving Shared Tech stock include the purchase of 282,100 shares between March 26 and July 11 at prices ranging from $5.00 to $8.43 a share.
Shared Technologies said last Thursday that it signed an agreement to merge into a unit of Tel-Save in a deal a company spokesman said was valued at about $511 million.
